name: Crepusculo Porto | January 23
description: Crepusculo, a kinky electronic music party with a mandatory fetish and avant-garde dress code, returns to Maus Hábitos on Saturday 23 January from 22:00 to 06:00.
longDescription:
Crepusculo, the party from Lisbon, comes back to Porto for its second episode. It is a kinky electronic music party with a sexy, avant-garde and fetish dress code, which is mandatory. There is face control at the door: a ticket does not guarantee entry, and anyone turned away is refunded without the platform fee.

The night runs on Saturday 23 January 2027 from 22:00 to 06:00 at Maus Hábitos, Rua de Passos Manuel 178, 4th floor. The space has several areas, including a dance floor, a consent-focused playroom, a chill and tea zone and an outdoor smoking area.

Early birds at €25 have sold out; the first release is €30 on Shotgun, with later releases at €35 and €40. Check the party rules on Instagram at @crepusculo.lisboa before going.
